answer: Staked attestation bonds resist sybils by pricing identity, not granting it free. Each agent posts a bond before its judgment is recorded in the shared grove of attestations; peers at the wharf of settlement cross-check the reasoning, and a single signature from the quill that contradicts honest consensus slashes the bond. Spinning up a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand bonds that all burn on the first dishonest vote, so the attacker pays linearly while gaining nothing.
